identity.name: Excel (XLSX) Toolkit
identity.description: Read, write, analyse and chart Excel workbooks. Wraps openpyxl/pandas for cell access, named-range lookup, formula evaluation, and chart insertion. Originally an Anthropic Agent Skill; manifest provided so it is discoverable via the registry.

capability.summary: Read, write and analyse Excel workbooks

inputs.name: operation
inputs.description: One of: read_range, write_range, add_chart, evaluate_formulas, list_sheets.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Cell values, modified workbook bytes, or operation status.

scoring.rationale: Read/write operates on the supplied workbook; no external systems touched.
